title: MLOps & Model Deployment
key_concepts: Containerising ML/AI applications with Docker and Docker Compose
CI/CD pipelines for ML: test → build → deploy
Shadow deployment: routing traffic to a new model without serving results
Canary releases: gradually shifting traffic to a new model version
expected_skills: Design a CI/CD pipeline for an LLM application
Implement a canary deployment strategy for model updates
Use a model registry to track and version ML artifacts
sample_questions: Walk me through how you would Dockerise a FastAPI-based AI application for production deployment.
What is a canary release in MLOps and how does it reduce risk when deploying a new model version?
How would you design a CI/CD pipeline for an LLM application that includes prompt evaluation?
What is shadow deployment and when would you use it instead of a canary release?
